europe_now.title: Hungary declares Russia a security threat
europe_now.summary: Hungary's government has formally designated Russia as a security threat, breaking with Prime Minister Orbán's long-standing policy of engagement. The decision marks a significant shift in Central European alignment amid the ongoing war in Ukraine.

sources.headline: Hungary declares Russia a ‘threat’, breaking with Orbán policy

europe_now.title: Russian-linked arson attempt on Slovak drone factory
europe_now.summary: Police in Slovakia have arrested three foreign suspects after an attempted napalm arson attack on a drone production facility, which authorities link to Russian intelligence. The incident underscores the expanding hybrid warfare targeting European defense industry.

sources.headline: Slovak drone factory narrowly escapes Russian-linked napalm arson attack as police arrest three foreign suspects

top_stories.title: Migration pressures at EU borders
top_stories.summary: Spanish authorities continue to manage asylum seekers in the Ceuta enclave while the United States provides equipment and training to bolster Poland's border defenses. These parallel developments underscore the ongoing challenge of irregular migration for the European Union.

sources.headline: Holding out in Ceuta until asylum is granted

top_stories.title: Iceland considers reopening EU accession talks
top_stories.summary: An Icelandic professor has warned that oligarchs could influence the outcome of a planned referendum on resuming EU membership negotiations. The vote represents a potential shift in Reykjavík's relationship with the bloc.

sources.headline: [Interview] Oligarchs could hijack Reykjavík’s EU referendum, Icelandic professor warns

top_stories.title: Germany reports increase in hybrid threat activity
top_stories.summary: German officials have indicated a rise in hybrid attacks targeting the country, attributing the activity to foreign state actors. The assessment reflects growing security concerns across the continent.

sources.headline: Germany increasingly in the crosshairs of hybrid attacks
